name: guard
description: Enforce evidence-backed claims in Claude Code. Ships a Grounded output style, logs each session's user/assistant turns with the assistant's claims and their supporting evidence, and (on demand via /guard:audit-evidence by default, or automatically each turn in subagent/headless mode) audits a turn for grounding — dispatching the evidence auditor subagent or an isolated headless judge that blocks. The approval gate (edit_gate) and the evidence judge (evidence_gate) are set with /guard:settings and controlled independently. Also ships /guard:audit-comment, which audits and fixes source comments for restating the code, going stale, or leaving intent unrecorded. Requires Python 3.11+. Claude Code only.
